a.name: Steel ledger
a.description: A deep-steel band: Maggie's photo on a sticky rail at the left, the three blocks as one numbered ledger of 19 questions beside it.
a.differs_from: A photo rail beside a numbered ledger on a deep band; the built rows carry no photo and sit plain or in a card.

b.name: Three trays
b.description: The three blocks side by side at 1024+ as three sunk steel-100 trays, each with a 1 of 3 tag, its question and tight chevron rows.
b.differs_from: Three sunk trays in three columns, no jump list; S1 is one plain column, S2 a heading beside one list, S3 one card with a jump list.

c.name: Lead answer
c.description: Each block under a steel rule: question left, answer right, its first question open as a large lead, the rest folded in two columns.
c.differs_from: An open lead answer over a two-column grid of folded rows, ruled; the built rows are one list, plain or in a card.
